mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing the always-on audit fact lets the model invent an authenticated access with no matching audit entry, which the AuditCompleteness assertion is supposed to forbid.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditMissing { some op: Operation | some op.authenticated and (no ae: AuditEntry | ae.forOp = op) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing per-operation uniqueness allows two AuditEntries to be created for the same operation — a direct violation of the append-only/immutable audit log invariant.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_DuplicateAudit { some disj ae1, ae2: AuditEntry | ae1.forOp = ae2.forOp }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing the canonical-envelope fact lets a denied operation respond with something other than ForbiddenEnvelope, which is exactly the existence-leak the NoInformationLeakage assertion catches.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_ResponseLeak { some op: Operation | some op.authenticated and op.outcome = Denied and op.response != ForbiddenEnvelope }

mutation_targets.rationale: Without the patient-own-record gating fact, the model can permit a patient to read a record other than their assignedRecord — the canonical ownership-based-access violation.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_PatientCrossAccess { some op: Operation, r: Record | some op.authenticated and op.caller.role = PatientRole and op.outcome = Permitted and op.targetRecord = r and r != op.caller.assignedRecord }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing the care-team gating fact allows a permitted clinician access without any CareTeamMembership row — the core HIPAA care-team-only invariant.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NonCareTeamClinicianGranted { some op: Operation | some op.authenticated and op.outcome = Permitted and op.caller.role = ClinicianRole and op.endpoint = GetRecord and (no m: CareTeamMembership | m.clinician = op.caller and m.record = op.targetRecord) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Without the clinician-author constraint, a ClinicalNote could be authored by a patient or compliance officer — violating the schema's author_role CHECK and FR-011's role snapshot.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NonClinicianAuthor { some n: ClinicalNote | n.authorRoleSnapshot != ClinicianRole }
